non_negotiables.title: AI persona disclosure
non_negotiables.rule: Every persona is disclosed as AI or synthetic on the profile and on promotional content.

non_negotiables.title: Material connection
non_negotiables.rule: Every post that promotes a house page, book, or product discloses the owned relationship to Inkbound Night Desk.

non_negotiables.title: No real-person likeness
non_negotiables.rule: No celebrity, no scraped face, no photo-reference of a real identifiable person.

non_negotiables.title: No fake proof
non_negotiables.rule: No invented reviews, ranks, awards, follower counts, now-live claims, or testimonials.

non_negotiables.title: No login or posting
non_negotiables.rule: This agency writes packets. A person posts. No credentials live in this repo.

non_negotiables.title: No kids mix
non_negotiables.rule: No children's YouTube work. No young-readers hard-sell from adult personas.

non_negotiables.title: No near-duplicate personas
non_negotiables.rule: A new influencer must differ in name, face lock, voice, and niche emphasis.
